title: Leo's Little Empire
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, cute expressive characters with big eyes, exaggerated funny facial expressions, vibrant colors, soft cinematic lighting, vertical 9:16

Anya.look: Young woman, 20s, bright eyes, curly brown hair tied in a messy bun. Wears a comfy, oversized yellow sweatshirt and ripped jeans. Energetic, often amused.

Leo.look: Toddler, 1 year old, chubby cheeks, big blue eyes. Always wears a tiny, impeccably neat blue button-up shirt and khaki shorts, even indoors. Looks innocent but has a shrewd gaze.

Priya.look: Woman, 30s, sleek black hair in a neat bob, stylish business casual dress. Looks stressed but loving.

Rahul.look: Man, 30s, neat beard, smart casual blue polo shirt. Looks slightly bewildered.

scenes.image: [[Anya]] entering a lavish living room, looking bewildered. On the fancy coffee table, a baby bottle is perfectly centered next to a stack of neatly folded blueprints. Her eyes are wide.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine socha baby sit karna easy hoga, par yeh kuch aur hi nikla!
scenes.say: मैंने सोचा बेबी सिट करना इजी होगा, पर ये कुछ और ही निकला!

scenes.image: Close-up on [[Anya]]'s face, a secret, mischievous smile forming as she puts a finger to her lips. The sound of a baby babbling faintly in the background.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya ko ek secret gift mila tha, woh babies ki baat samajhti thi.
scenes.say: अन्या को एक सीक्रेट गिफ्ट मिला था, वो बेबीज की बात समझती थी।

scenes.image: [[Priya]], a busy mom, handing [[Anya]] a list of instructions, looking stressed. [[Rahul]] giving a quick wave behind her.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Anya, Leo bahut easy hai. Bas feed karna aur sulana.
scenes.say: अन्या, लियो बहुत इजी है। बस फीड करना और सुलाना।

scenes.image: [[Rahul]] whispering to [[Anya]], pointing towards the nursery door. He looks a bit tired.
scenes.speaker: Rahul
scenes.line: Haan, bas uska mood achha rakhna. Bahut smart hai.
scenes.say: हाँ, बस उसका मूड अच्छा रखना। बहुत स्मार्ट है।

scenes.image: [[Anya]] nodding confidently, holding the long instruction list. She winks playfully.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Don't worry, main sambhal lungi. Enjoy your dinner!
scenes.say: डोंट वरी, मैं संभाल लूंगी। एंजॉय योर डिनर!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] and [[Rahul]] leaving, relief clear on their faces. The front door closing behind them.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Parents chale gaye. Ab bas Anya aur chhota Leo the.
scenes.say: पेरेंट्स चले गए। अब बस अन्या और छोटा लियो थे।

scenes.image: [[Anya]] walking into a perfectly organized nursery. [[Leo]] is sitting in his crib, looking stern, not smiling, holding a small, shiny 'tablet' toy.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Hello Leo! Kaise ho mere chhotu?
scenes.say: हैलो लियो! कैसे हो मेरे छोटू?

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Leo]]'s face, he slowly turns his head towards [[Anya]], a tiny, almost imperceptible smirk on his lips.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Ga-ga-goo! (Finally! She arrived. Let the games begin.)
scenes.say: गा-गा-गू! (फाइनली! शी अराइव्ड। लेट द गेम्स बिगिन।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]]'s eyes widen slightly. She heard his actual thought. She quickly composes herself.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Wait, did he just... talk? Like, really talk?
scenes.say: वेट, डिड ही जस्ट... टॉक? लाइक, रियली टॉक?

scenes.image: [[Leo]] making urgent babbling sounds, pointing his tiny finger towards a specific red block in a toy pile.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Baa-baa-boo! (Get the red block! Now! Don't dawdle.)
scenes.say: बा-बा-बू! (गेट द रेड ब्लॉक! नाउ! डोंट ड्वॉडल।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] picking up the red block, looking confused. She thought she heard a command.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Okay, red block. Aisa laga jaise order de raha tha.
scenes.say: ओके, रेड ब्लॉक। ऐसा लगा जैसे ऑर्डर दे रहा था।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] on the floor, surrounded by toys, pointing to a 'mood chart' on the wall (with happy, sad, angry toy faces).
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaa! (The happy toys go here! The sad ones there!)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गा! (द हैप्पी टॉयज गो हियर! द सैड वन्स देअर!)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] sorting toys by 'emotions', her eyebrows raised in disbelief. She's doing it, but looks puzzled.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Seriously? Toys ki feelings bhi samajhni padegi?
scenes.say: सीरियसली? टॉयज की फीलिंग्स भी समझनी पड़ेगी?

scenes.image: [[Leo]] crawling quickly towards the kitchen door, making determined babbling sounds.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Da-da-da! (Kitchen! Mission: secret snack patrol!)
scenes.say: डा-डा-डा! (किचन! मिशन: सीक्रेट स्नैक पेट्रोल!)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] following [[Leo]] into the kitchen, a mix of amusement and suspicion on her face. She sees him pointing to the top shelf.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Woh kya hai? Iske orders toh kuch alag hi hain.
scenes.say: वो क्या है? इसके ऑर्डर्स तो कुछ अलग ही हैं।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] in his high chair, banging his spoon, demanding something specific on the highest shelf. His expression is firm.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaga! (The sparkly banana chips! Only those!)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गागा! (द स्पार्कली बनाना चिप्स! ओनली दोस!)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] stretching to reach the top shelf, looking exasperated. The 'sparkly banana chips' are just regular banana chips.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Sparkly banana chips? Yeh toh normal waale hain na?
scenes.say: स्पार्कली बनाना चिप्स? ये तो नॉर्मल वाले हैं ना?

scenes.image: [[Leo]] pouting, shaking his head vehemently, refusing the regular chips. He crosses his arms.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Booh-booh! (No! Not shiny enough! You failed the test.)
scenes.say: बू-बू! (नो! नॉट शाइनी इनफ! यू फेल्ड द टेस्ट।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] slumping against the counter, utterly defeated by the baby's precise snack demands. Her jaw drops slightly.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Mera dimaag ghum raha hai. Yeh kya ho raha hai?
scenes.say: मेरा दिमाग घूम रहा है। ये क्या हो रहा है?

scenes.image: [[Leo]] then points to the living room, specifically the remote control. His eyes are narrowed.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Baa-ga-boo! (Now, the TV remote. My stories are waiting.)
scenes.say: बा-गा-बू! (नाउ, द टीवी रिमोट। माय स्टोरीज आर वेटिंग।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] handing him the remote, looking completely bewildered. He takes it with surprising dexterity.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Yeh toh kuch zyada hi control kar raha hai sab kuch.
scenes.say: ये तो कुछ ज्यादा ही कंट्रोल कर रहा है सब कुछ।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] on the floor, now using the remote. The TV screen (off-screen) shows a complex financial news channel, not cartoons.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Gaa-ga-goo! (The stock market report! Important stuff!)
scenes.say: गा-गा-गू! (द स्टॉक मार्केट रिपोर्ट! इम्पोर्टेन्ट स्टफ!)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] peeking at the TV, her eyes wide with shock. Financial news? From a baby?
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Stocks? Yeh toh children's rhymes nahi hain!
scenes.say: स्टॉक्स? ये तो चिल्ड्रन्स राइम्स नहीं हैं!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] turns his head slowly, giving [[Anya]] a stern, almost disapproving look.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Boo-hoo-ga! (Silence! This is crucial data, Anya.)
scenes.say: बू-हू-गा! (साइलेंस! दिस इज क्रूशियल डेटा, अन्या।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] looks genuinely scared, shrinking slightly. This baby is not messing around.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Okay, okay, sorry! Main chup rahungi. Boss, I mean Leo.
scenes.say: ओके, ओके, सॉरी! मैं चुप रहूंगी। बॉस, आई मीन लियो।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] then points to a vacuum cleaner in the corner, with an authoritative gesture.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-maa! (Clean up this mess! Now, swiftly.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-मा! (क्लीन अप दिस मेस! नाउ, स्विफ्टली।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] hesitantly picks up the vacuum cleaner, her face a mask of confusion and slight fear. She was told just to babysit.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Babysitter ya house-help? Yeh toh totally confusing hai!
scenes.say: बेबीसिटर या हाउस-हेल्प? ये तो टोटली कन्फ्यूजिंग है!

scenes.image: While Anya is vacuuming, [[Leo]] secretly pulls a tiny, sleek tablet from under his high chair tray, hiding it from Anya.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya vacuum kar rahi thi, tabhi Leo ne kuch chhupaya.
scenes.say: अन्या वैक्यूम कर रही थी, तभी लियो ने कुछ छुपाया।

scenes.image: Close-up on [[Leo]]'s tiny fingers expertly swiping on the tablet screen. He looks intensely focused, a small headset on.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaa! (Confirm inventory update. Order more organic quinoa.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गा! (कन्फर्म इन्वेंटरी अपडेट। ऑर्डर मोर ऑर्गेनिक क्विनोआ।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] stops vacuuming, hearing a faint, high-pitched voice from Leo's direction. She slowly turns.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Yeh awaaz kahan se aa rahi hai? Aur quinoa?
scenes.say: ये आवाज़ कहाँ से आ रही है? और क्विनोआ?

scenes.image: [[Anya]] creeping closer to [[Leo]], who quickly shoves the tablet back under his high chair. He looks innocent again.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Leo, kya kar rahe the tum? Kuch sunai diya mujhe.
scenes.say: लियो, क्या कर रहे थे तुम? कुछ सुनाई दिया मुझे।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] gives [[Anya]] a wide, innocent smile, babbling sweetly, as if nothing happened. He holds a soft toy.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Dada-goo-goo! (Just playing with Mr. Bear, Anya.)
scenes.say: दादा-गू-गू! (जस्ट प्लेइंग विद मिस्टर बेयर, अन्या।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]]'s eyes narrow. She is suspicious. She glances at the high chair tray.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Mr. Bear, huh? Mujhe lagta hai Mr. Bear kuch aur hai.
scenes.say: मिस्टर बेयर, हंह? मुझे लगता है मिस्टर बेयर कुछ और है।

scenes.image: [[Anya]] pretends to be distracted, looking out the window, then quickly peeks under the high chair. Her eyes widen in shock.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya ne ek chance liya aur jhuk kar dekha.
scenes.say: अन्या ने एक चांस लिया और झुक कर देखा।

scenes.image: Close-up of a small, futuristic tablet hidden perfectly under the high chair tray. A spreadsheet is visible on its screen.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Wahan ek chhota, high-tech tablet tha!
scenes.say: वहाँ एक छोटा, हाई-टेक टैबलेट था!

scenes.image: [[Anya]]'s face, jaw dropped, eyes bugged out. Utter disbelief. She finally understands.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Oh my god! Yeh toh pura household manage kar raha hai!
scenes.say: ओह माय गॉड! ये तो पूरा हाउसहोल्ड मैनेज कर रहा है!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] on his high chair, his 'innocent' smile slowly fading as he realizes Anya saw the tablet. His eyes are now sharp.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaa? (You saw that, didn't you, Anya?)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गा? (यू सॉ दैट, डिडन्ट यू, अन्या?)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] pointing at the tablet, then at Leo, then at herself. Her expression is a mix of shock and dawning realization.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Tum... tum ho asli boss! Aur parents ko kuch nahi pata!
scenes.say: तुम... तुम हो असली बॉस! और पेरेंट्स को कुछ नहीं पता!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] sighs dramatically, rolling his eyes like an old man. He gestures for Anya to sit down.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Baa-ga-boo! (Of course! They're adorable, but clueless.)
scenes.say: बा-गा-बू! (ऑफ कोर्स! दे आर अडोरेबल, बट क्लूलेस।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] sitting opposite Leo, still in shock. He leans forward conspiratorially.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-ma! (Now that you know, you're part of the team.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-मा! (नाउ दैट यू नो, यू आर पार्ट ऑफ द टीम।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] looking from the tablet to Leo, a slow smile spreading across her face. This is incredible.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Team? Hum toh house-management kaafi kar lenge!
scenes.say: टीम? हम तो हाउस-मैनेजमेंट काफ़ी कर लेंगे!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] showing Anya a complex calendar on his tablet. It's full of appointments and tasks for the house.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Da-da-goo! (First, optimize the grocery budget. Project 'Banana Chips'.)
scenes.say: डा-डा-गू! (फर्स्ट, ऑप्टिमाइज द ग्रोसरी बजट। प्रोजेक्ट 'बनाना चिप्स'।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] nodding enthusiastically, leaning in to see the tablet. Her initial fear replaced by excitement.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Banana chips mein sparkle add karte hain! Project 'Glittery Snacks'.
scenes.say: बनाना चिप्स में स्पार्कल ऐड करते हैं! प्रोजेक्ट 'ग्लिटरी स्नैक्स'।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] gives Anya a thumbs up, a rare, genuine smile on his face. He found a capable assistant.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaa! (Excellent! You're hired. Permanent position.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गा! (एक्सीलेंट! यू आर हायरर्ड। परमानेंट पोजीशन।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] and [[Leo]] side-by-side, both looking at the tablet intently, like co-CEOs, deep in discussion.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Aur aise shuru hui Anya aur Leo ki secret partnership.
scenes.say: और ऐसे शुरू हुई अन्या और लियो की सीक्रेट पार्टनरशिप।

scenes.image: A montage: [[Anya]] strategically placing a 'missing' toy for [[Leo]] to 'find' and give orders about. Both smiling.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya ne uske orders ko samjha aur uski help ki.
scenes.say: अन्या ने उसके ऑर्डर्स को समझा और उसकी हेल्प की।

scenes.image: Montage: [[Anya]] pretending to 'struggle' with a task, while [[Leo]] 'supervises' intently from his high chair, tablet glowing subtly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Leo ne usse ghar ke saare raaz bataye.
scenes.say: लियो ने उससे घर के सारे राज़ बताए।

scenes.image: Montage: [[Anya]] and [[Leo]] share a secret high-five, looking sly, after 'successfully' reorganizing the pantry.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unki bonding zabardast ho gayi thi.
scenes.say: उनकी बॉन्डिंग ज़बरदस्त हो गई थी।

scenes.image: Nighttime: [[Anya]] tucking [[Leo]] into bed. He's holding a small, disguised 'earpiece' in his hand, a tiny smile on his face.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-na! (Good night, Anya. Don't forget tomorrow's agenda.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-ना! (गुड नाइट, अन्या। डोंट फॉरगेट टुमॉरोज़ एजेंडा।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] winking at [[Leo]], giving him a knowing nod. She feels like a co-manager, not just a babysitter.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Of course, boss! Kal subah milte hain.
scenes.say: ऑफ कोर्स, बॉस! कल सुबह मिलते हैं।

scenes.image: The front door opening. [[Priya]] and [[Rahul]] entering, looking tired but happy. [[Anya]] quickly hides her knowing smile.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Hum wapas aa gaye! Kaisa raha din, Anya?
scenes.say: हम वापस आ गए! कैसा रहा दिन, अन्या?

scenes.image: [[Anya]] puts on her innocent babysitter face, gesturing to the perfectly tidy living room. [[Leo]] is 'sleeping' in his crib.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Sab theek tha! Leo bahut sweet hai, so gaya.
scenes.say: सब ठीक था! लियो बहुत स्वीट है, सो गया।

scenes.image: [[Rahul]] smiling, looking around the clean house. He high-fives [[Anya]].
scenes.speaker: Rahul
scenes.line: Wow, ghar kitna saaf hai! Tum toh magic ho!
scenes.say: वाह, घर कितना साफ़ है! तुम तो मैजिक हो!

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Leo]] 'sleeping' in his crib, one eye subtly open, watching [[Anya]] with a triumphant smirk. The tiny headset is almost hidden.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Gaa-ga-goo! (Mission accomplished, Anya. Keep up the good work.)
scenes.say: गा-गा-गू! (मिशन अकम्प्लिश्ड, अन्या। कीप अप द गुड वर्क।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] catching Leo's gaze, a secret understanding passing between them. She winks almost imperceptibly at him.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Ji sir! Aapke orders sir aankhon par!
scenes.say: जी सर! आपके ऑर्डर्स सिर आँखों पर!

scenes.image: [[Priya]] handing [[Anya]] payment, looking happy and oblivious.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Thank you so much! You're the best babysitter ever!
scenes.say: थैंक यू सो मच! यू आर द बेस्ट बेबीसिटर एवर!

scenes.image: [[Anya]] taking the money, but looking at [[Leo]] with a conspiratorial smirk. She has an inside joke now.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: It's my pleasure! See you next time, I hope!
scenes.say: इट्स माय प्लेज़र! सी यू नेक्स्ट टाइम, आई होप!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] giving a tiny, almost royal nod from his crib. He already considers her indispensable.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-baa! (Indeed. My schedule demands your presence.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-बा! (इंडीड़। माय शेड्यूल डिमांड्स योर प्रेज़ेंस।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] leaving the house, a huge, amused smile on her face. She feels a new kind of satisfaction.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya jaante thi ki uska next shift bahut busy hoga.
scenes.say: अन्या जानते थी कि उसका नेक्स्ट शिफ्ट बहुत बिजी होगा।

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Priya]] and [[Rahul]] looking at their sleeping baby, completely unaware of his secret life. They look loving.
scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.line: Kitna masoom hai na? Din bhar bas khelta hai.
scenes.say: कितना मासूम है ना? दिन भर बस खेलता है।

scenes.image: [[Rahul]] nodding, oblivious. He gently pats Leo's head.
scenes.speaker: Rahul
scenes.line: Haan, chhota sa cute baccha! Ghar mein aur kya karta hoga.
scenes.say: हाँ, छोटा सा क्यूट बच्चा! घर में और क्या करता होगा।

scenes.image: Zoom out to show the entire living room. The blueprints are still on the coffee table, next to the baby bottle.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Par Leo ka 'khel' toh bahut bada tha.
scenes.say: पर लियो का 'खेल' तो बहुत बड़ा था।

scenes.image: Close-up on the blueprints on the coffee table: they are detailed floor plans, with 'PROJECT LEO: PHASE 2' written on them.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Woh toh pura ghar chala raha tha!
scenes.say: वो तो पूरा घर चला रहा था!

scenes.image: [[Anya]] walking away from the house, looking back with a knowing, conspiratorial smile. She's found her calling.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Kaun kehta hai babies sirf rote hain? Yeh toh business karte hain!
scenes.say: कौन कहता है बेबीज सिर्फ रोते हैं? ये तो बिजनेस करते हैं!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] in his crib, looking directly at the camera with a sly, confident wink. The tiny tablet briefly flashes under his high chair.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaa! (Don't tell anyone, okay? It's our secret!)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गा! (डोंट टेल एनीवन, ओके? इट्स आवर सीक्रेट!)

scenes.image: Close-up on a notepad on the kitchen counter, where 'Today's Agenda' is written in neat adult handwriting, but with tiny, careful baby hand-drawn stars next to each task.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya ne finally asli ghar ka boss dhund liya tha.
scenes.say: अन्या ने फाइनली असली घर का बॉस ढूंढ लिया था।

scenes.image: [[Anya]]'s face, a wide grin. She holds up a tiny gold star sticker, looking proud.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Promotion mil gaya! Assistant Manager of Chaos, I mean, Home!
scenes.say: प्रमोशन मिल गया! असिस्टेंट मैनेजर ऑफ केओस, आई मीन, होम!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] on his high chair, looking at a wall calendar with a tiny pen, meticulously ticking off tasks. He looks very serious.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-gaa! (Next on the agenda: parental supervision. They need guidance.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-गा! (नेक्स्ट ऑन द एजेंडा: पैरेंटल सुपरविजन। दे नीड गाइडेंस।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] peeking around the corner, trying to stifle her laughter. She can't believe this baby.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Parents ko guidance? Yeh toh next level hai!
scenes.say: पेरेंट्स को गाइडेंस? ये तो नेक्स्ट लेवल है!

scenes.image: A wide shot of the living room, clean and organized. The parents are on the sofa, scrolling phones, completely oblivious.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Unhe kya pata, unka chhota sa beta mastermind hai.
scenes.say: उन्हें क्या पता, उनका छोटा सा बेटा मास्टरमाइंड है।

scenes.image: Close-up on [[Leo]]'s tablet, which now shows a 'performance review' for his parents, with green checkmarks for 'Loving' and red crosses for 'Awareness'.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Boo-hoo-gaa! (Still needs improvement in 'Following Directives'.)
scenes.say: बू-हू-गा! (स्टिल नीड्स इम्प्रूवमेंट इन 'फॉलोइंग डायरेक्टिव्स'।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] shaking her head, smiling fondly at the scene. She grabs a snack for herself.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Sabko lagta hai baby innocent hai. Par yeh toh CEO hai!
scenes.say: सबको लगता है बेबी इनोसेंट है। पर ये तो सीईओ है!

scenes.image: [[Leo]] looking at [[Anya]] with a very serious, calculating expression, as if assessing her loyalty.
scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Goo-goo-ma! (Remember, Anya. Loose lips sink ships. And high chairs.)
scenes.say: गू-गू-मा! (रिमेंबर, अन्या। लूज़ लिप्स सिंक शिप्स। एंड हाई चेयर्स।)

scenes.image: [[Anya]] puts a finger to her lips, making a zipping motion. She totally gets it.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: My lips are sealed, Leo. Your secret is safe with me.
scenes.say: माय लिप्स आर सील्ड, लियो। योर सीक्रेट इज सेफ विथ मी।

scenes.image: [[Leo]] giving a tiny nod of approval, then going back to his tablet. The 'Project Leo' blueprints are visible on a side table.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Anya ko uska naya role mil gaya tha.
scenes.say: अन्या को उसका नया रोल मिल गया था।

scenes.image: [[Anya]] walking past the parents, who are still oblivious. She winks at the camera.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Next time when a baby cries, maybe he's just giving orders!
scenes.say: नेक्स्ट टाइम व्हेन अ बेबी क्राइज, मेबी ही इज जस्ट गिविंग ऑर्डर्स!

scenes.image: Close-up of [[Leo]]'s tiny feet dangling from his high chair. He's wearing tiny, perfectly polished shoes.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ghar ka asli boss toh wahi tha.
scenes.say: घर का असली बॉस तो वही था।

scenes.image: [[Anya]] leaving the house, looking over her shoulder with a playful smile. She has a tiny badge on her sweater that says 'Assistant Manager'.
scenes.speaker: Anya
scenes.line: Toh aapko kya lagta hai, ghar ka asli boss kaun tha?
scenes.say: तो आपको क्या लगता है, घर का असली बॉस कौन था?

caption: This Babysitter Understood Baby Talk... And Found A Secret!
yt_title: This Babysitter Understood Baby Talk... And Found A Secret!
description:
This new babysitter thought she just had to watch a cute baby, but he had other plans.
She understood his babbling and uncovered his shocking little secret!
Who do YOU think is the real boss of the house?
